title: seew-television
label: Polecat

won.source: No bestowal survives in the held record; Polecat holds the title entering the fed's own last card (12 July 1997).

end.source: The same card's own text: Polecat, after retaining, announces he will vacate the title.

how: Retained via double-disqualification against Killer Kenny of the Black Widows, following a Mystic Beast Kings/Black Widows run-in; vacated minutes later in a post-match promo announcing intent to pursue Mike 'the Mechanic' Malone for the SEEW Heavyweight Championship instead.
note: The corpus does not carry the bestowal that began this reign; this is its own only surviving defense, on the fed's own last card.
